item.title: VCF 9 - VKS with NSX VPCs and AVI
item.description:
Introduction

In my last blog post I wrote about the integration of VKS with NSX and VPCs. As LoadBalancer I used the NSX native version and the AVI integration was not done. In addition to the last blog post I will describe now how VPCs can be used for VKS in combination with AVI. If you already used AVI for VKS in the past you might be already aware of some limitations like Service Engines vNIC limit which might be solved with the VPC based AVI integration. Further the AVI integration with VPCs takes advantage of tenancy capabilities of AVI, which is also a great enhancement from my point of view. Sure there are still some limitations and problems in the new integration, but if not it would be boring.

item.title: VCF 9 - VKS with NSX VPCs
item.description:
Introduction

K8s is already a crucial part in the VMware ecosystem for many years and the level of integration in other products like NSX and AVI changed a lot in the past. That is also true for the naming like “vSphere with Tanzu”, “vSphere IaaS” and “VKS” and perhaps more changes in the future. For this blog post we will bring some spotlight to the integration for VKS with NSX VPCs, which is from my point of view a great enhancement from tenancy point of view.
